title.narrative: Herat Health Infrastructure Enhancement Project in Afghanistan

description.narrative: As part of the UN's coordinated effort to meet the needs of individuals impacted by the October 2023 Herat Earthquake, UNOPS is committed to improving access to and the resilience of health services and facilities in areas affected by the earthquake. This will be achieved through various means, including minor maintenance interventions and procurement. \n
